## Changes

Describe the user-visible change and affected Rust crates.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results, including failures, skips, and host architectures. Terminal changes need expected-output tests and a real-terminal exercise.

- [ ] Cargo formatting, Clippy, workspace tests, and build passed
- [ ] Platform checks required by CONTRIBUTING.md ran
- [ ] A user-visible change has a CHANGELOG.md entry
- [ ] The owning README is updated

## Upstream

For an upstream port, link its release or commit, explain adaptations, and retain its license notices and tests.
